schema:name: Demographic selection criterion for the NYC Immigrant Enclaves map, as reported
schema:text: The Washington Examiner reports that a City Hall spokesperson, in a statement to the New York Post, defended the map by saying it "highlights neighborhoods in New York City that have substantial foreign-born populations from regions and countries around the world." The predicate is present-tense foreign-born population share. This wording appears on no Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs page or document inspected by the governed collection, and in no published rule.
dcterms:description: Moderate confidence because the criterion wording is quoted verbatim but relayed by one outlet, while a conflicting office attribution reported elsewhere remains unresolved.
